units.rawText: My memory data tells me that "The Oasis is my home".
units.displayText: My memory data tells me that "The Oasis is my home".

spans.text: My memory data tells me that "The Oasis is my home".

units.rawText: Before I came back to the Oasis, it felt like there was a wall between me and those words, but after seeing it in person, it felt as though there was a splash of color in those monochrome memories and that some part of me was slowly coming to "life".

units.rawText: I'm glad I'm back in the Oasis, that I can see everyone again, and that I can... I... are these tears?
